# Extract month from Date column and filter for November games
df['Month'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Date'], format='%B %d').dt.month
november_games = df[df['Month'] == 11]

# Extract points scored from Results\nScore column
# Points are the first number before the dash
november_games['Points'] = november_games['Results\nScore'].str.extract(r'^(\d+)').astype(int)

# Sum the points
answer = november_games['Points'].sum()
answer
